messages:
Maya (docs): opened PR #5486 updating the migration guide and adding a new streaming SDK snippet for embeddings. small content change but caught a hard-coded KMS ARN in the example — will redact before merge.
Ethan (platform): can you paste the preview link when it's up? want to verify the changed heading slug doesn't break the sidebar.
Maya (docs): sure. snippet that needs redaction:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(kms_key=\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444455556666:key/00aa11bb22cc\")
embed = client.stream_embed(\"hello world\")
```
Zoe (sdk): yep redact that. use the canonical placeholder `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID`. also replace any real-looking api_key strings with `REPLACE_WITH_API_KEY`.
Rina (security): please open an RD ticket for the sensitive-docs flow and tag it example-credentials. I can try to triage today but legal needs to sign off too.
Maya (docs): opening RD-321 and adding PR link now. adding a one-line advisory about not pasting live credentials in examples/CI logs.
sensitive-docs-bot: RD-321 created for PR #5486  status: pending triage
preview-bot: preview build queued for PR #5486  https://ci.example.com/builds/5486
Ethan (platform): build shows a link-check warning on the updated heading slug. I can add a redirect rule after merge, but prefer not to block this redaction fix.
Rina (security): we don't skip link-checks. but security OKs the placeholder swap. will mark RD-321 for quick review.
Omar (legal): quick note: if examples reference customer keys we should have a clear advisory line: "Avoid pasting live keys or credentials into docs or CI logs; use placeholders." I can propose exact wording.
Maya (docs): added Omar's advisory and swapped the ARN to the placeholder. pushed the change, retriggering preview.
preview-bot: preview succeeded for PR #5486  https://ci.example.com/builds/5486/preview
Rina (security): reviewed RD-321 and the placeholder  security :thumbsup: passing to legal.
Omar (legal): reviewed and left a tiny tone change (soften "do not" to "avoid"). otherwise LGTM.
Zoe (sdk): can someone run a local preview? CI sometimes caches older assets and shows flaky link-check errors. happy to run it and share a URL if helpful.
Ethan (platform): if Zoe can run a local build that matches CI and post the link, I'll regenerate the link-check index on the platform side.
Zoe (sdk): running local now, should have a temp preview in ~8m.
Zoe (sdk): local preview link (internal): http://local-preview.example/5486 
Maya (docs): nice, local preview looks clean. can we merge during the docs merge window tomorrow at 11:00 PT if legal posts the formal approval?
Omar (legal): fine to merge in that window, I'll leave a comment approving the language in the PR.
Rina (security): if legal approves, security is OK. please DM me if legal requests a hold.
Maya (docs): thanks everyone. merging in the 11:00 PT window and will add a changelog note. will also create a follow-up sweep ticket to search for any other literal ARNs across docs/examples.
Ethan (platform): filing sweep ticket and will schedule it for next sprint.
preview-bot: deploy queued for main (PR #5486)  will publish after merge.
